## Checklist

- [ ] One feature or fix per PR
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] For a bug fix: the new test fails without the fix (say how you checked)
- [ ] Tests check what the user would see, not only that a function was called (see `AGENTS.md`)
- [ ] Ran `npm run test:all` locally and it passes (needs `npx playwright install chromium` once)
- [ ] `npm run build:frontend` passes (type-check)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` and the clippy command from CONTRIBUTING.md are clean
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (under `## Unreleased`) if user-facing
